name: Microwave Chickpea Curry
ingredients: 1 small onion and 2 tomatoes, finely chopped
1 tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp chilli powder, ¼ tsp turmeric
steps: In a large bowl, microwave the oil, cumin, onion, garlic and ginger covered for 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and spices, cover and microwave for 4 minutes until pulpy.
Stir in the chickpeas and ½ cup water, cover and microwave for 5 minutes.
Mash a few chickpeas to thicken, then stand for 2 minutes.
Finish with garam masala, lemon and coriander.
note: Made with canned or pre-cooked chickpeas, this takes under 15 minutes.
